title: AI Content Forensics
summary: Reverse-engineer an inspectable creator corpus into evidence-linked content rules, copyable templates, and one verified ten-post thread without predicting performance.
triggers: turn this creator corpus into copyable templates

inputs.name: bounded local or connected creator corpus and evidence-linked finding candidates

outputs.name: constitutions, insight audit, exact ten-post thread, optional visuals, and body-free receipt

free_capabilities: local JSON, JSONL, or CSV corpus preparation
platform-separated deterministic coverage and cohort analysis
evidence-bound constitutions and ten-post thread validation
body-free receipt and optional local SVG/HTML visuals
paid_capability_stubs: connected owned-account reads depend on current Threadify scopes and entitlement
live multi-platform public collection can use a separately configured host connector such as Scrape Creators with its own account and credits

must_show: provider, observation time, and source rights
seven findings and their evidence IDs
exact ten-post draft and destination platform

instructions: Ask for an owner-approved local export or bounded URL manifest when connected reads are unavailable.
Keep incomplete coverage and unavailable metrics explicit; use descriptive analysis when comparative evidence is insufficient.
Return the complete local draft package without claiming a provider save, schedule, publication, causation, or future result.
